summary: The customer called to complain about a high bill and an unexpected automatic renewal of their contract, demanding an immediate cancellation without extra fees. The agent explained the renewal policy and initially mentioned early termination fees, but after the customer threatened to switch providers and file a complaint, the agent transferred the call to the complaints department to cancel the contract without fees.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Transfer the customer to the complaints department to process the contract cancellation without fees.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm and professional demeanor throughout the call, even when the customer became frustrated and accusatory.
